steps.eval: window.__pill = []; setInterval(() => { const p = document.querySelector('.load-pill'), s = `${p.className} | ${p.textContent}`; if (__pill.at(-1) !== s) __pill.push(s); }, 50)

steps.assert: __pill.some((s) => / buffering| \| logs \d+\/\d+ · /.test(s)) && __pill.at(-1).includes('done') || `the pill never showed progress: ${__pill.join(' → ')}`

import('/status.js').then((m) => { const kinds = m.status.kinds(), data = kinds.filter((k) => /^(logs|can)$/i.test(k.name)), states = (k) => `${k.name} ${k.segs.map((s) => s.state).join(' ')}`; const open = data.filter((k) => k.segs.some((s) => !['ready', 'disk', 'missing'].includes(s.state))), bad = kinds.filter((k) => k.segs.some((s) => s.state === 'error')); return data.length > 0 && !open.length && !bad.length || `lanes not filled: ${[...open, ...bad].map(states).join('; ') || 'no logs lane'}`; })
